scope: Each selected middle observation was inspected with its three original cameras and available adjacent observations, and exact-target same-arm physics through t-1. Approvals apply ONLY to the issued GRASP member at that anchor. No whole-clip action, planner, recovery or task-success approval.
criterion: Specified target physically grasped by the same compatible arm for all six preceding applied controls; closure, reward and future evidence are insufficient. GRASP success does not certify lifting, transport, retained contents or usefulness to the overall task.
